note: Standing-context byte budgets (spec 2026-08-03, `pnpm context:check`). Every byte musterd injects into a seat's context — tools/list render, primer, hook nudges — measured statically from source-of-truth exports. Raising any budget requires replacing that item's `justification`. bytes are UTF-8 of the model-readable text; estTokens = bytes/4 (the SurfaceRender formula).

toolsListDefaultBytes.justification: 2026-08-27 (17416 B, +team_insight_search alias team_memory_search — ADR 327 amendment, one-meaning-per-word) + 5% headroom. Pays rent via ADR 327 eval.

toolsListMutedBytes.justification: 2026-09-03 re-baseline (7659 B) + 5% headroom. Two things bought this raise, and the second is the reason it is a re-baseline rather than a bump: (1) `team_join {wait}` (ADR 095) costs 91 B and pays rent by removing a measured stall — of 33 claim requests opened from an MCP surface since 2026-07-03, only 5 were decided inside the 120s block the argument makes optional (docs/wiki/claim-approval-latency.md); (2) the prior budget was set 2026-08-27 at 7232 B + 5%, and main had drifted to 7568 B by 2026-09-03 — 336 of its 362 B headroom spent by unattributed growth, so the next byte from any source was going to fail this gate whoever added it. Falsify the rent: if no seat uses `wait: 0` by the next re-baseline, cut the argument and take the bytes back.

perTurnTotalBytes.justification: 2026-09-28 (ADR 468): the 2026-08-27 ceiling (18487 B = 17606 B + 5%) minus the 103 B labelNudgeBytes part, which left the composition with the label sweep it announced. The parts still exactly spend the ceiling (the coherence test's binding rule). Pays rent via ADR 327 eval, reviewed at next re-baseline.

perSessionTotalBytes.justification: 2026-09-28 (ADR 468): the 2026-08-27 ceiling (21833 B = 20793 B + 5%) minus the 103 B labelNudgeBytes part
